verdicts.reason: Both are almost the same square crop. Each zooms into the figs and cuts off the cake base and plate, so the dessert reads as a pile of fruit rather than a tart. The 'Perfect Taste' wreath sits in the upper middle over the busy blurred photo, as in the original, with the right-hand leaves running into the fig slices. A's headline is slightly larger and fills the wreath closer to the original's proportions. B's headline is a touch smaller and sits a little looser inside the wreath. Neither difference is big enough to call a winner, and neither crop rearranges the layout to suit the square format.
